name: Titles And Names Of Ministers
overview: Scripture reveals that ministers hold vital roles as shepherds, watchmen, and servants appointed by God to guide, protect, and nourish His people. Prophets like Ezekiel and Isaiah describe ministers as watchmen who faithfully warn and remind the people of the Lord's truth, while Jeremiah emphasizes their responsibility to feed the flock with knowledge and understanding. Additionally, the priests, as ministers of the sanctuary, serve directly in the presence of God, highlighting the sacred nature of their service. These titles collectively underscore the divine calling and diverse functions of ministers in the life of the church.
